title: Mini Bramble Crumbles
description: Individual apple and blackberry crumbles topped with an oat and egg-white crumble baked separately for extra crunch.
ingredients: Filling: 4 apples (sweet variety e.g. Gala, peeled and chopped), 150g blackberries, 1 tsp vanilla extract, ½ tsp ground cinnamon, 100ml water
Crumble: 1 egg white, 80g oats, 1 tbsp maple syrup, ½ tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tsp demerara sugar
steps: Put all filling ingredients in a small saucepan; bring to boil; simmer gently 20 minutes.
Whisk egg white 1 minute until soft and fluffy; stir in oats, maple syrup and cinnamon.
Spread oat mixture as thinly as possible on a lined baking tray; bake on top shelf 10 minutes.
Cool crumble slightly; break up with hands into crumble pieces.
Mash filling slightly; divide between 4 ramekins. Sprinkle crumble and ½ tsp demerara sugar over each.
Bake all 4 ramekins on a tray for 10 minutes until golden and crunchy. Serve warm.
notes: Substitute with apple & raspberry, apple & blueberry, or just apples if blackberries unavailable.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
